requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online for services such as haircuts, shaves, and beard trims.
The system should allow customers to choose their preferred barber based on availability during the booking process.
Each barber should have the ability to update their own availability in the system to prevent double bookings.
The system should be cost-effective and easy to set up and run without complicating the experience for the shop or customers.
Automated reminders should be sent to customers via both SMS and email to help them remember their appointments.
